name: Cross Mod Mono Styles
author: Freek van Gool
description: Tunes for Cross Mod Mono by music style: techno, acid, house, trance, ambient, synthwave, electro, drum & bass, dub, hip-hop, chiptune and funk & disco, plus drum & bass folders for neurofunk (sync and cross modulation), detune stacks, liquid, dancefloor, jump up, jungle and leads. Bass, lead, pad, stab and effect sounds, plus self-playing bass lines (own pattern) and arpeggios.
